reports.name: BTW aangifte
reports.description: Quarterly Dutch VAT return and payment for ordinary BTW filers in the 2026 calendar year.

workflows.name: Reconcile quarterly BTW
workflows.description: Reconcile output BTW, deductible input BTW, corrections, and any prior-period adjustments before filing.

workflows.name: Submit BTW aangifte
workflows.description: Submit the quarterly BTW return during the month after the quarter.

workflows.name: Pay quarterly BTW
workflows.description: Pay the resulting BTW balance by the same deadline as the quarterly return.

events.title: Q1 2026 BTW submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly BTW return for Q1 is submitted in April and due by 30 April.

events.title: Q1 2026 BTW payment deadline
events.description: Any payable BTW for Q1 is due with the return by 30 April.

events.title: Q2 2026 BTW submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly BTW return for Q2 is submitted in July and due by 31 July.

events.title: Q2 2026 BTW payment deadline
events.description: Any payable BTW for Q2 is due with the return by 31 July.

events.title: Q3 2026 BTW submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly BTW return for Q3 is submitted in October and due by 31 October.

events.title: Q3 2026 BTW payment deadline
events.description: Any payable BTW for Q3 is due with the return by 31 October.

events.title: Q4 2026 BTW submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly BTW return for Q4 is submitted in January of the following year and due by 31 January.

events.title: Q4 2026 BTW payment deadline
events.description: Any payable BTW for Q4 is due with the return by 31 January of the following year.

reports.name: Annual BTW aangifte
reports.description: Annual Dutch VAT return and payment path for BTW filers assigned to annual filing for the 2026 calendar year.

workflows.name: Confirm annual BTW filing
workflows.description: Confirm the taxpayer has an annual BTW return period rather than monthly or quarterly filing.

workflows.name: Reconcile annual BTW
workflows.description: Reconcile annual taxable turnover, deductible input BTW, and corrections before filing.

workflows.name: Submit and pay annual BTW
workflows.description: Submit the annual BTW return and pay the resulting balance before 1 April of the following year.

events.title: 2026 annual BTW submission deadline
events.description: Annual BTW return for 2026 is due before 1 April of the following year.

events.title: 2026 annual BTW payment deadline
events.description: Any payable annual BTW for 2026 is due by 31 March of the following year.

reports.name: Opgaaf ICP
reports.description: Recapitulative statement for qualifying intra-EU supplies in the 2026 calendar year.

workflows.name: Review intra-EU activity
workflows.description: Review EU customer VAT IDs, intra-Community goods supplies, qualifying services, and transfers of own goods.

workflows.name: Determine ICP frequency
workflows.description: Confirm whether the taxpayer files ICP monthly, quarterly, or annually under a permit before relying on the quarterly window.

workflows.name: Submit Opgaaf ICP
workflows.description: Submit the ICP statement within two months after the applicable period when intra-EU supplies were made.

events.title: Q1 2026 ICP submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly ICP statement for Q1 is available after the quarter and can be submitted within two months after the period.

events.title: Q2 2026 ICP submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly ICP statement for Q2 is available after the quarter and can be submitted within two months after the period.

events.title: Q3 2026 ICP submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly ICP statement for Q3 is available after the quarter and can be submitted within two months after the period.

events.title: Q4 2026 ICP submission deadline
events.description: Quarterly ICP statement for Q4 is available after the quarter and can be submitted within two months after the period.

reports.name: OSS BTW melding
reports.description: Quarterly One Stop Shop VAT notification and payment for covered cross-border B2C EU activity in the 2026 calendar year.

workflows.name: Confirm OSS scope
workflows.description: Confirm the activity is covered by the Union One Stop Shop and remains separate from ordinary domestic BTW filing.

workflows.name: Prepare OSS country totals
workflows.description: Prepare country-level taxable turnover, rates, corrections, and nil-period status for the OSS quarter.

workflows.name: Submit and pay OSS BTW
workflows.description: Submit the OSS VAT notification in the month after the quarter and pay the balance in one payment.

events.title: Q1 2026 OSS submission deadline
events.description: OSS VAT for Q1 is reported in April and due by the last day of that month.

events.title: Q1 2026 OSS payment deadline
events.description: Any payable OSS VAT for Q1 is due with the OSS notification.

events.title: Q2 2026 OSS submission deadline
events.description: OSS VAT for Q2 is reported in July and due by the last day of that month.

events.title: Q2 2026 OSS payment deadline
events.description: Any payable OSS VAT for Q2 is due with the OSS notification.

events.title: Q3 2026 OSS submission deadline
events.description: OSS VAT for Q3 is reported in October and due by the last day of that month.

events.title: Q3 2026 OSS payment deadline
events.description: Any payable OSS VAT for Q3 is due with the OSS notification.

events.title: Q4 2026 OSS submission deadline
events.description: OSS VAT for Q4 is reported in January of the following year and due by the last day of that month.

events.title: Q4 2026 OSS payment deadline
events.description: Any payable OSS VAT for Q4 is due with the OSS notification.

reports.name: Inkomstenbelasting
reports.description: Annual Dutch personal income tax return workflow for the 2026 income year.

workflows.name: Confirm income tax obligation
workflows.description: Confirm whether an income tax return letter or other filing trigger applies for the income year.

workflows.name: Prepare income tax return
workflows.description: Gather wage, business, deduction, partner, box 2, box 3, and pre-filled return data before submission.

workflows.name: Submit income tax return
workflows.description: Submit before the date in the return letter; the general annual deadline is often 1 May.

events.title: 2026 income tax submission deadline
events.description: The annual income tax return is commonly submitted from March and is generally due by 1 May unless the return letter states another date.
